item.description:
• Updates back up your Kit's memory before they touch anything; the dump lands in backups next to your data.
  • A hosted model key that stops working now says so in Settings > Models instead of failing quietly on the third reply.
  • Old suspicions on memories resolve themselves: cleared, or kept as a visible note, never pending forever.
  • Restore works across the Docker-to-native move: docker-era backups read fine on the native runtime.
  • The import backlog tells the truth about its direction: draining, growing, or stuck, with the cause named.
